_authoring_conventions.note: Same conventions as fixtures/cinderella — see fixtures/authoring-notes.md. This package is original, written for this repository; nothing in it is adapted from an existing work.
_authoring_conventions.entry_state_and_exit_state: { <entity_id>: { <column>: <value>, ... }, ... } — one object per touched entity, naming only the core columns this scene asserts.
_authoring_conventions.new_rows_in_exit_state: Reserved keys _new_relationships / _new_character_knowledge, using the same row shape as world_model_seed.
_authoring_conventions.why_this_fixture_exists: Five scenes — the longest of the three short packages, and the one that exercises must_stay_hidden across a whole story: the same fact is withheld by four scenes and paid off by the fifth.
_authoring_conventions.characters_present_includes_the_absent: char_innes is listed in characters_present for the two scenes whose beats name him, though he is not in the room. characters_present is what the deterministic join reads: a character a beat names but the list omits reaches the writer as a name with no World Model row behind it, which the compiler reports as missing_fact.
_authoring_conventions.seed_grounded_payoff: scene_05 pays off innes_vanished_in_february with plant: null — a fact no scene plants because a character_knowledge row establishes it before the story opens (ADR 0004).

characters.name: Aldous Reeve
characters.goal: keep the light for eight weeks and go home

bag.note: has never worked a rock station before and has said so to nobody

bag.trade: boatman on the Cairn Head relief run
bag.note: has landed at this station twice a year for nineteen years and will not stay the night
walked off the station in February; the boat found the door open and the light burning

bag.description: an open launch that comes alongside the rock twice a year and does not linger
twelve iron rungs up wet rock, and a door at the top of them
a stove, two chairs, one of them worn, and the log on the table
eighty-one steps, granite, wet at the bottom in any weather
glass on all sides, brass at the centre, and the sea on every horizon
a brass-housed light that should not be lit by day and is
one line a watch, in the same hand for eleven years
set at the foot of the stair, turned to face the way up

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Land the keeper, strand him, and put the story's one impossible fact in front of the reader while there is still an ordinary explanation available.
required_beats: Kerr puts Reeve on the rungs with his chest and his bedding and does not cut the engine
Kerr says the next boat is in eight weeks and that he has never once stayed the night here
the lamp is burning as Reeve climbs, in daylight, hours before any keeper would light it
Reeve tells himself the Board must have left it lit, and writes the time of his landing in the log
scene_cards.tone: grey, practical, a dread that has not declared itself
invariants: Reeve is alone on the rock when the boat goes
nothing in the scene is presented as supernatural

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Give the absence a name and a handwriting, and put one date in the record that cannot be where it is.
required_beats: Reeve reads back through eleven years of Tomas Innes keeping one line a watch, wind and glass and oil
the entries stop in February, which is what the Board told him to expect
the last entry is dated three days after that, in the same hand, and says only that the light was kept
Reeve leaves the log open on the table and does not write under it
scene_cards.tone: close, quiet, the horror arriving as a clerical discrepancy
invariants: the handwriting is never described as Reeve's own
Innes does not appear; only his hand does

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Turn the discrepancy physical: something is on the rock with him, and the evidence only points one way.
required_beats: there are wet prints on the granite, going up, and Reeve counts them twice to be sure
there is no set coming down, and the sea has not been over the rock in three days
a pair of sea-boots stands at the foot of the stair, dripping, turned to face the way up
Reeve puts his own boot beside a print and does not let himself finish the comparison
scene_cards.tone: airless; the reader is a step ahead of the narrator and cannot warn him
invariants: Reeve never says the prints are his size
nothing is seen; only left behind

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Take the last ordinary explanation away: the work is being done, correctly, by somebody who is not him.
required_beats: Reeve climbs at dusk to light the lamp and finds it already lit and the brass already warm
the oil is down by exactly one watch and the wick is trimmed the way he trims it
he keeps the watch anyway, because keeping it is the only thing on the rock he still knows how to do
at midnight he writes one line in the log: the light was kept
scene_cards.tone: resigned, almost peaceful; a man doing his job inside something he has stopped arguing with
invariants: Reeve does not search the tower
the line he writes matches the wording of the last entry in the log

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Collect everything at once: the lamp that was lit before he landed, and the vanishing the Board's letter told him about, are the same event seen from inside it.
required_beats: the relief boat comes alongside eight weeks to the day and Reeve goes down the rungs with his chest
Kerr looks up at him from the launch and greets him by the name Tomas Innes, the way you greet a man you have landed supplies for since he was young
Reeve turns back and the lamp is burning above him in daylight, exactly as it was on the day he landed
he goes back up the rungs, because the light has to be kept, and Kerr does not cut the engine
scene_cards.tone: cold, complete, no explanation offered and none needed
invariants: nobody in the scene explains what has happened
the story ends with the light still being kept

voice_card.narrative_distance: close on Reeve and never once ahead of him; the reader sees more than he admits
voice_card.register: spare, weather-worn, procedural about work and evasive about fear
voice_card.sentence_rhythm: long sentences for the sea and the stair, then a short one that stops the paragraph dead
imagery_palette: grey water with no horizon in it
voice_card.dialogue_density: very low; Kerr speaks twice in the whole story and both times it matters
voice_card.style_exemplar: The light was burning when he came up the rungs, in daylight, and he told himself the Board had left it so.
